verdict.rationale: Brave documents an in-browser API playground where you pick an endpoint, see its parameters, and try it live (docs-65). It also has per-endpoint API reference pages with parameter docs (e.g. Answers, News, Place Search) and copyable curl examples. Together these deliver an explorable, runnable API reference. Missing for 10: detail on how the playground works and whether try-it is embedded in each reference page, multi-language code samples, a public OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
